meta.title: Douyin
meta.description: Douyin auto companion: auto-replies to DMs and post comments, browses the feed and picks videos, with persona and long-term memory.

section.title: Douyin Companion
section.intro: It watches DMs and comments in the background, speaks through the host model and remembers what was talked about.

fields.voiceReply: Send a voice note after the reply
fields.commentSelf: Reply to comments on my own posts
fields.commentOthers: Reply to comments on other people's posts
fields.shareToPeer: Forward picked videos to the peer

hints.model: Leave empty to follow the model chosen in DSH settings; pick one explicitly to show its real name in the status bar.
hints.commentOthers: Off by default: commenting on other people's posts invites reports and risk control.
